quest.Name: The Great Egg-Hunt Begins
quest.Accomplishment: By request of Ditzy-Fly, I am tasked with finding as many of their lost kin as I can and return them to her. My reward will be entry to their city.
quest.Hagiograph: =name= scoured the lands, hunting eggs in the name of the anesheym and their great shah.

step.Name: Find egglings to deliver to the Anesheym.
step.text: Scour the lands of Qud in search of the lost children of the Anesheym, a sacred bug-folk hidden in the region known as Bevidd.

step.Name: Egg'sellent Hunting Skills!
step.text: You found enough eggs to impress the nobles of Rhemhez'Qen! You have been granted access to the city. Ditzy says you should head down and speak to the Grand Shah.

quest.Name: The Shah, and the City that Waits Upon the Long Sigh
quest.Accomplishment: You recieved a gift from the shah of Rhemhex'Qen, but also learned there seemed to be more the shah needed. Maybe you should go speak with her?

step.Name: Speak with the Shah.
step.text: Return to Rhemhex'Qen and speak with the Shah.
